Hi Ben —

Great demo — thanks. A few notes from procurement:

- Primary route: PO (standard vendor onboarding + SOW + signed contract). Typical internal cycle is 3–4 weeks for a new vendor unless we onboard via our cloud marketplace, which can be 3–5 business days.
- Card exceptions: procurement will allow corporate card spend for pilots under $2,000/month but it requires an approval from our Finance Ops owner (cc'd: Liam).
- Vendor paperwork: we need a completed supplier questionnaire (I attached a blank that your team already sent), W-9 / tax form, proof of insurance (COI), and SOC 2 Type II report if you store any customer data.
- Invoicing: we use Ariba for PO-based billing; if you can invoice via email for card charges that speeds the pilot flow.

Can you send the completed questionnaire and a short SOW with estimated monthly spend for the pilot? If we can do marketplace onboarding, please flag that as an option on the SOW.

Thanks —
Elena Torres
Procurement Manager, SkyForge Bio
